speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Trigger Finger (Stenosing Tenosynovitis) or Acute De Quervain's Tenosynovitis of the Flexor Digitorum Profundus.

The mechanism of injury (finger caught and pulled) combined with localized swelling at the distal interphalangeal joint suggests a tendon sheath injury rather than an infection. Does the pain improve when you rest the finger, and is there any locking or catching sensation when you try to straighten the finger?

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
